headline: Marriott Opens First Luxury Edition Hotel in Africa at Cape Town Waterfront
summary: Marriott launched Africa's first Edition hotel, a 142-room luxury development costing over 1 billion rand ($55M) at Cape Town's V&A Waterfront, featuring five dining venues and a rooftop pool.
why: Marriott International is the world's largest hospitality company; expanding its luxury Edition footprint reflects rising institutional investment in South Africa's high-end tourism sector.
